standard: Kain, 21 November 2026: the questions must really reflect helpful questions, chosen by how often or how likely they are asked, and a question block says who we are and what we do, never who we are not. A question fails if it (a) answers what Achology is not, (b) is not really asked by a visitor, or (c) is two questions in one title.
